content:
**Glowing Fungus Puree** are a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A puree made from Glowing Fungus, with added Firecap and pepper.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Firecap (2) Glowing Fungus (2) Pepper (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Glowing Fungus Puree | | Glowing Fungus Puree (1) | 

- Craftable at any Cooking Station after having learned the recipe.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is run in "Proletariat" mode.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
